status: Research only; no affiliate account enrollment or tracked links configured.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.description: A conversational AI workspace for drafting, revising, analyzing materials and exploring questions.
tools.bestFor: Turn your own lesson notes into a draft activity, then ask for targeted revisions.
tools.reviewNote: Choose the appropriate school account and review factual claims before sharing a response.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: An AI assistant for discussing ideas, working with documents and drafting teaching materials.
tools.bestFor: Compare supplied source excerpts or revise a resource using clear classroom constraints.
tools.reviewNote: Check generated quotations against the source and make sure suggested curriculum links fit your actual course.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.description: Google’s conversational AI can help with planning, explanations, practice materials and document work.
tools.bestFor: Brainstorm several lesson approaches and adapt one for a specific learning goal.
tools.reviewNote: Student access and available features depend on the account and school settings.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.description: Microsoft’s AI assistant supports drafting, summarizing and working with materials in its education ecosystem.
tools.bestFor: Draft a lesson outline or summarize supplied materials within a Microsoft 365 workflow.
tools.reviewNote: Check which features your school license and administrator have enabled.

tools.name: Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)
tools.description: Google’s source-based research notebook turns supplied materials into cited answers and study resources.
tools.bestFor: Build a notebook from a small, reviewed source set and ask learners to inspect the cited passages.
tools.reviewNote: A source-based answer is limited by the material you supply; citations still need checking in context.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.description: An AI answer and research tool that connects responses with linked web or academic sources.
tools.bestFor: Find possible research leads and follow the citations to the original publications.
tools.reviewNote: Open each source and check that it supports the specific claim rather than trusting the summary.

tools.name: Elicit
tools.description: An AI research assistant for finding scientific papers and organizing evidence across studies.
tools.bestFor: Explore education research and compare study methods or findings in a structured table.
tools.reviewNote: Its scientific-literature workflow is not a substitute for searching primary historical archives.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.description: An academic search tool that finds research papers and produces cited summaries or comparisons.
tools.bestFor: Explore a focused research question, then compare what the underlying studies actually measured.
tools.reviewNote: Read study methods and limitations before treating an across-paper summary as a settled conclusion.

tools.name: MagicSchool
tools.description: An education-focused collection of AI tools for lesson drafts, questions, rubrics and other classroom materials.
tools.bestFor: Start with a lesson-planning template and adapt the resulting activity for your class.
tools.reviewNote: Review the content and assessment alignment; a generated draft is not a final lesson.

tools.name: Eduaide
tools.description: A guided AI workspace for creating, revising and exporting teaching resources.
tools.bestFor: Create a worksheet or lesson from a topic, goal or source without starting from a blank chat.
tools.reviewNote: Check the chosen standard and exported layout against your actual instructional needs.

tools.name: Diffit
tools.description: A teacher resource tool that adapts supplied content into activities, reading supports and editable materials.
tools.bestFor: Turn a reviewed passage into differentiated practice, vocabulary work or a station activity.
tools.reviewNote: Compare adapted text with the original so important meaning and historical language are not lost.

tools.name: SchoolAI
tools.description: A platform for teacher-designed AI learning experiences and classroom monitoring.
tools.bestFor: Build a focused learning Space that guides students through a topic or practice task.
tools.reviewNote: Preview the student experience and decide what responses you will monitor before assigning it.

tools.name: Brisk Teaching
tools.description: An AI teaching assistant that creates resources and drafts feedback inside common browser-based workflows.
tools.bestFor: Draft rubric-based feedback, then review and personalize it before posting.
tools.reviewNote: Keep feedback tied to visible student work and review every suggestion before sharing.

tools.name: Curipod
tools.description: An interactive lesson platform with AI-supported activities, student responses and feedback.
tools.bestFor: Run a discussion or writing activity with opportunities for learners to revise their responses.
tools.reviewNote: Preview activities and use moderation before projecting student responses.

tools.name: Wayground
tools.description: A classroom assessment platform whose AI tools draft questions from prompts, documents, websites and videos.
tools.bestFor: Create a practice assessment from a resource you have already reviewed.
tools.reviewNote: Check each question, answer choice and answer key before assigning the assessment.

tools.name: Formative
tools.description: An instructional and assessment platform with AI-assisted question creation and live response monitoring.
tools.bestFor: Turn a worksheet or topic into an interactive check for understanding.
tools.reviewNote: Keep final scoring decisions with the teacher and inspect generated questions for ambiguity.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.description: An AI writing assistant offering suggestions for clarity, grammar, tone and revision.
tools.bestFor: Model how to consider a writing suggestion and explain whether to accept or reject it.
tools.reviewNote: Check which generative features are available for your institution and preserve the learner’s own meaning.

tools.name: QuillBot
tools.description: A writing toolkit with AI-supported paraphrasing, summarizing, grammar and related drafting tools.
tools.bestFor: Compare an original passage with a suggested paraphrase while discussing meaning and attribution.
tools.reviewNote: Rewording does not remove the need to credit a source or follow the assignment’s AI rules.

tools.name: ReadTheory
tools.description: A reading-practice platform with an AI passage builder for teacher-reviewed passages and questions.
tools.bestFor: Create a topic-linked reading passage and comprehension activity for classroom review.
tools.reviewNote: Read the passage and check the answer key before giving learners the worksheet.

tools.name: DeepL Write
tools.description: An AI writing companion that suggests wording, grammar, style and tone changes.
tools.bestFor: Refine instructions or compare alternative wording for a short classroom communication.
tools.reviewNote: Language and feature coverage vary; check that revisions preserve the intended meaning and voice.

tools.name: Canva
tools.description: AI-assisted design tools help turn ideas and supplied media into editable classroom visuals.
tools.bestFor: Draft a class poster, visual organizer or presentation layout.
tools.reviewNote: Check image details, reading order and any elements that require a paid license before exporting.
tools.affiliateNote: Canvassador is the affiliate pathway; its official help page says applications are currently closed.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.description: Generate and edit images and other creative media from written instructions.
tools.bestFor: Create an original illustration to explain a concept or introduce a topic.
tools.reviewNote: Label generated historical scenes as illustrations and check objects, clothing and text rather than treating them as evidence.
tools.affiliateNote: Adobe lists an affiliate program; eligibility of a specific Firefly purchase needs confirmation before promotion.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.description: Create images from prompts or supported reference images, including designs containing text.
tools.bestFor: Explore poster concepts or illustrative classroom visuals.
tools.reviewNote: Read every word in generated images and review whether your plan publishes generations publicly.

tools.name: Leonardo.Ai
tools.description: Generate, refine and upscale visual assets, with image and video creation tools.
tools.bestFor: Explore several visual approaches to a lesson concept or character illustration.
tools.reviewNote: Review visual accuracy and consistency before using an image in instructional materials.
tools.affiliateNote: The creator program mentions affiliate access, but applications are currently on hold; a waitlist is offered.

tools.name: Runway
tools.description: Generate video from text or images and refine motion through creative video tools.
tools.bestFor: Create a short visual introduction or a clearly labeled imagined scene.
tools.reviewNote: Preview motion and factual details; a generated scene is not documentary footage.

tools.name: Synthesia
tools.description: Turn scripts, documents or prompts into videos using AI presenters and voiceovers.
tools.bestFor: Produce a short procedural explanation or staff training video.
tools.reviewNote: Review pronunciation, captions and script accuracy, and make the synthetic presenter clear to viewers.
tools.affiliateNote: Public application program; acceptance and placement terms must be reviewed before using a tracked link.

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.description: Create presenter videos with AI avatars and video translation tools.
tools.bestFor: Prepare an introductory explanation or multilingual version of a reviewed script.
tools.reviewNote: Review translations and pronunciation, and use avatar or voice likenesses only with appropriate permission.
tools.affiliateNote: Official program requires original video content and says no SEO or blog-only promotion; not a ready fit for a directory-only ad.

tools.name: Pictory
tools.description: Convert scripts and documents into videos with editing, captions and voiceover tools.
tools.bestFor: Turn a teacher-written explanation into a short captioned learning video.
tools.reviewNote: Check that selected visuals actually support the explanation and that captions match the finished audio.
tools.affiliateNote: Public marketing-partner program includes affiliate commissions; approval and terms still need review.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.description: Generate spoken narration and create or transcribe audio using AI voice tools.
tools.bestFor: Record a reviewed lesson narration or an alternate audio version of written directions.
tools.reviewNote: Check names and subject vocabulary, and use voice cloning only with appropriate permission.
tools.affiliateNote: Public affiliate program with approval and disclosure requirements; no enrollment or tracked link has been created.

tools.name: Descript
tools.description: Edit recorded audio and video through a transcript, with caption and sound-enhancement tools.
tools.bestFor: Trim a teacher explanation and prepare a transcript or captions for review.
tools.reviewNote: Check transcript edits against the recording so cutting text does not change the intended meaning.
tools.affiliateNote: Official program is managed through PartnerStack; an application must be approved before tracked promotion.

tools.name: Otter
tools.description: Transcribe recorded conversations and organize them into searchable notes and summaries.
tools.bestFor: Prepare reviewed notes from an approved adult professional-learning meeting or lecture.
tools.reviewNote: Check recording permissions first, then verify names, quotations and action items against the audio.
tools.affiliateNote: Official partner program lists referral and affiliate arrangements; specifics are agreed after review.

tools.name: Adobe Podcast
tools.description: Enhance spoken recordings and work with audio through browser-based tools.
tools.bestFor: Improve the clarity of a teacher-recorded explanation before sharing it.
tools.reviewNote: Listen to the entire enhanced recording; processing can change the character of a voice or background sound.
tools.affiliateNote: Adobe has a general affiliate program, but eligibility of this specific product was not verified.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.description: Use AI to outline and design presentations, documents and other visual content.
tools.bestFor: Draft a slide sequence from a reviewed lesson outline.
tools.reviewNote: Check factual claims, source links and exported slide layout before presenting.
tools.affiliateNote: Official help page lists an application process; acceptance is not automatic.

tools.name: Beautiful.ai
tools.description: Build presentations with AI drafting and layouts that automatically arrange slide elements.
tools.bestFor: Create a clear visual explanation or professional-learning deck.
tools.reviewNote: Review both content and export behavior; automatic layouts may need adjustment for your teaching materials.
tools.affiliateNote: Public program terms list application-only enrollment and require approval for paid advertising or special offers.

tools.name: Plus AI
tools.description: Create, edit and reformat presentations inside Google Slides or PowerPoint.
tools.bestFor: Turn a reviewed document or outline into editable classroom slides.
tools.reviewNote: Review the outline before generating and check whether the exported deck retains the layout you need.
tools.affiliateNote: Official affiliate page describes an application and review process.

tools.name: SlidesAI
tools.description: Turn prompts, notes and documents into presentations through web and slide-editor tools.
tools.bestFor: Create a first draft of a lesson presentation from your own notes.
tools.reviewNote: Review reading load, factual claims and image relevance before using the slides with learners.
tools.affiliateNote: The official product footer links to this affiliate portal; public program details beyond the portal were not verified.

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.description: Work with notes, pages, tasks and databases using an AI assistant inside Notion.
tools.bestFor: Organize lesson-planning notes and turn reviewed meeting notes into a task list.
tools.reviewNote: Check which workspace and connected-app content the assistant can access before relying on a summary.
tools.affiliateNote: Official affiliate page says the program is currently not accepting new affiliates.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.description: Connect apps and add AI steps to workflows that reduce repetitive administrative work.
tools.bestFor: Move non-confidential form responses into a planning checklist for teacher review.
tools.reviewNote: Test with sample data and review the trigger, actions and destinations before enabling an automation.
tools.affiliateNote: Official ambassador and affiliate terms were posted November 6, 2026; application approval is required.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.description: Use AI assistance within Microsoft work apps to draft, summarize and organize material.
tools.bestFor: Draft a document, presentation or meeting summary using approved work content.
tools.reviewNote: Features depend on your organization’s configuration and license; verify what your school account actually includes.

tools.name: Gemini in Google Workspace
tools.description: Use Gemini assistance within Google work apps for writing, summaries, slides and planning.
tools.bestFor: Refine a teacher-written document or organize a planning sheet within an approved Workspace account.
tools.reviewNote: Check feature access for your school edition and review generated wording and summaries before sharing.
tools.affiliateNote: Google lists distinct referral and higher-volume affiliate programs; check eligibility and eligible business plans before use.
